items.title: Is PayPal Holdings (PYPL) Undervalued After Earnings And Its Recent Share Price Jump?
items.summary: PayPal Holdings (PYPL) recently reported second quarter 2026 earnings, with sales of US$8,682 million and net income of US$1,104 million.
